_doc: Every place built from the show's own frame (tools/td-camp/clean.py). Coordinates are the 1600x900 reference pixels. src: the frame (traced/src). cut/fill: people removed. night: a night frame (its warm lights twinkle on their own). wind: how hard the wind blows here (0 indoors). fire [x, foot y, flame h]. fall [x0,y0,x1,y1] a waterfall. pool [x0,y0,x1,y1, fish, water sample x, y]. mist [y0,y1]. flutter [x0,y0,x1,y1] butterflies. sway [x0,y0,x1,y1, strength] everything not sky in the box sways (pines, bushes the leaf colour misses). cloth [x0,y0,x1,y1, strength] flags, banners, curtains. bob [[x,y],...] a polygon that rocks on the water. glow [x0,y0,x1,y1] lights that twinkle by day. still [x0,y0,x1,y1] never sways (a leaf mat on a floor). noleaf: no automatic foliage. lightning: a storm.
